Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one transparent animation-frame PNG for the oneBeat comic cast.
Primary request: EDIT Image 1 only: match its ink rendering to the existing characters in Images 2–4, remove the whole pale background and lower-right black "AI生成" lettering and rounded box, reconstruct any obscured shoe, and draw natural line-art ground contact shadows.
Input roles: Image 1 is the only pose, proportions, framing and character-identity authority. Images 2–4 (lilroll, mismatch, wave) are linework and comic-rendering references only. Do not borrow their clothing, facial features, poses or props.
Style: bold, mildly irregular variable-weight black contours, thinner confident interior folds, restrained short fine directional hatch marks on hat, clothing and footwear, saturated flat cel colors with a few simple shadow planes. Hand-drawn comic ink like the established cast, not soft 3D, painterly, generic anime or overly clean vector art. Add restrained hatching without clutter.
Preserve exactly: floppy orange bucket/boonie hat shape and tilt, shaggy black hair, lavender skin, cool half-lidded eye, mouthless natural right-facing profile looking forward toward screen-right (never at camera), bright blue loose windbreaker with ivory sleeve panels and black bands, black zip and pockets, ivory undershirt, yellow cargo shorts with their actual pockets/folds, black socks, chunky violet/ivory/orange/black lace-up sneakers. Preserve each frame's own jacket opening, body rotation, hat angle, hands and original joint angles. No costume or facial redesign, no changed palette.
Composition: single whole character, square canvas preferably 1254×1254. Keep Image 1's normalized scale, margins, head/body/hand/foot positions and ground baseline. Preserve both shoe orientations, exact raised-foot height and arm swing. Eye-level viewpoint, no camera perspective change, no reframing or cropping.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA, including gaps around fingers, sleeve and legs. No remaining pale background, no halo, white/gray/black canvas or checkerboard texture.
Contact shadows: very low, tapered charcoal/black ink strokes with fine horizontal hatching and visible transparent gaps at the original ground baseline. A dense short patch beneath the planted sole, or a tiny dense patch where a trailing toe actually contacts the floor. Keep much lighter if adding an airborne foot's projected shadow, always on the ground baseline. No blur, solid filled oval, glow, floor strip, long ground line or floating shadow attached to a raised shoe.
Remove all lower-right text and its rounded outline COMPLETELY, including where black glyphs or box lines overlap the violet panels, black laces and ivory outsole. Reconstruct the shoe's underlying contours/colors using the original target's visible portions.
Change only ink/line rendering, modest cel shading, background and label removal, and line-drawn contact shadows. Keep all other elements faithful. Output one frame, no collage, words, logos, watermark, badge, frame or additional objects.
Pose-specific constraints: Frame 01: huge straight-leg forward kick toward screen-right with sneaker toe-up and well above the ground. Screen-left back sneaker is planted. Near arm stretches forward almost horizontally with a fist, rear arm swings back down-left. Preserve the exact target's broad stride and sleeve silhouette.
